correctionSummary.reason: Final system release closing the correctness-remediation and visual-modernization program for The Wrong Color of Light.
corrections: C2C3-PACE01 Declared class-period route. The undeclared 125-minute core route is now an explicitly declared multi-period route.
C2C3-T02 Rubric system. The Full/Partial rubric was replaced by the common quick rubric plus the full 4/3/2/1 analytic rubric.
C2C3-ACC01 Accessible workload. Accessible Task 5 required ten source-analysis responses plus synthesis; the writing load was reduced without changing the accepted response space.
C2C3-T01 Teacher structure is validated against the corrected functional set rather than a fixed page count.
C2C3-VIS01, VIS02 and VIS03 GRO-9 discrete spectral display, response-band overlay and the spectral-match mechanism/specification panel modernized through the shared visual layer.
unchanged: Curriculum wording beyond the corrections listed above, scientific conclusions, task order, response controls and persistence identities, presentation CSS, layout overrides, fixed Letter page geometry and learner-field sizing are unchanged from the owner-approved corrective and visually modernized state. The release conversion itself changed lifecycle metadata and records only.
